parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json;const candidate=r.candidates?.[0];if(!candidate||candidate.finishReason!=='STOP')throw new Error('GEMINI_REPLY_UNFINISHED_'+String(candidate?.finishReason||'NO_CANDIDATE'));const text=(candidate.content?.parts||[]).filter(p=>p.thought!==true&&typeof p.text==='string').map(p=>p.text).join('');let p;try{p=JSON.parse(text);}catch{throw new Error('GEMINI_REPLY_INVALID_JSON');}const fields=['reply','intent','needs_team','wants_visit','visit_date','patient_name','service_ids'];if(!p||Array.isArray(p)||Object.keys(p).length!==fields.length||fields.some(k=>!(k in p))||typeof p.reply!=='string'||!p.reply.trim()||p.reply.length>2500||!['information','medical','visit_request','handoff'].includes(p.intent)||typeof p.needs_team!=='boolean'||typeof p.wants_visit!=='boolean'||typeof p.visit_date!=='string'||typeof p.patient_name!=='string'||!Array.isArray(p.service_ids)||p.service_ids.some(x=>typeof x!=='string'))throw new Error('GEMINI_REPLY_SCHEMA_INVALID');return [{json:{output:p,model_usage:r.usageMetadata||{}}}];

parameters.jsCode: const s=$('Settings').first(0, 0).json;if(!s.settings.telegram.enabled)return [];const raw=$input.first().json;const stage=String(raw.error?.node?.name||raw.error?.context?.nodeName||raw.error?.name||'C06 Direct').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9 _-]/g,'').slice(0,80);return [{json:{text:'⚠️ مشكلة تشغيل في سكرتير العيادة\nخطوة '+stage+' ما كملتش بنجاح.\nراجع آخر محادثة واردة في واتساب.',chat_id:s.settings.telegram.chat_id,event_key:s.event.instance+':'+s.event.message_id}}];
